stage_0.description: 只加载 core/schema/空存档骨架，用于工程骨架验收。

stage_1A.description: 白菜种植、保质期、菜窖、拆分、腌制、腊肉炒白菜、酒馆订单闭环。

stage_1B.description: 在 1A 基础上接入家庭饭食、水缸挑水、工具耐久和燃料轻量逻辑。

stage_1C_debug.description: 旧案空底座、医馆清淡餐调试、鱼汤扣水调试。

game_version.notes: Single source: configs/core/rule_versions.yaml version_bundle.game_version. Do not hardcode a divergent SaveFile game_version constant.

storage_reconciliation_policy.used_capacity_rule: sum slot_weight storage_footprint.amount for all StorageOccupants whose storage_ref.container_id equals container_id
storage_reconciliation_policy.overflow_policy: NewGameBuilder must fail validation when reconciled used_capacity exceeds container capacity.amount
storage_reconciliation_policy.extension_policy: Future water_storage/currency_storage/special containers may declare a separate capacity model, but must be registered before bypassing slot_weight reconciliation.
storage_reconciliation_policy.occupant_source: SaveFile.inventory + SaveFile.dish_lots + future registered storable object collections
storage_reconciliation_policy.object_ref_cache_rule: active_object_refs stores common_defs.StorageOccupantRef entries, not generic RuntimeObjectRef or material-only ids

configs/core/feature_flag_dependencies.y.extension_policy: Parent flag false disables runtime entry gates of normal child flags. Child flags may remain true as configured defaults for later stages; they are inert until every required parent is true. Debug overlay gates are evaluated separately by allowed_stages / debug profile policy, so a normal gameplay parent can remain false while a debug-only gate is true.

child_can_self_feed.stage_1A_note: Stage 1A may keep this configured true for future Stage 1B defaults, but UI and Action gates must not open while family_meal_enabled=false.

allow_buy_meal_substitute.stage_1A_note: Stage 1A may keep this configured true for future Stage 1B defaults, but UI and Action gates must not open while family_meal_enabled=false.

clinic_order_debug_enabled.extension_note: This gate only exposes debug validation entry in explicitly allowed debug stages. It does not open the normal clinic order pool while clinic_order_enabled=false.

old_case_debug_enabled.disabled_behavior: debug_stub_only; no formal old-case content opens until old_case_content_enabled=true

notes: Stage 1A 只跑最小经营闭环；SaveFile 可以保留 home_water 字段，但不开放挑水、扣水、家庭饭食、医馆、旧案调试。
燃料可做轻量消耗验证；工具/设施耐久完整反馈推迟到 Stage 1B。

resolver_type_contract.property: read from dish_profile or material property_profile
resolver_type_contract.field: read from top-level object fields, such as DishLot.serving_count
resolver_type_contract.tag: read only from DishLot.suitability_tags; cook_dish must merge DishStructure.demand_tags into DishLot.suitability_tags when recognized_dish_id is set
resolver_type_contract.defect: read from defects list or defect map

notes: 订单截止时间允许 Stage 1A 自动验收链完成作物成长、存储对比、腌制、烹饪和提交。

runtime_initialization_policy.mapping_coverage_required: Every SaveFile property must have a direct_map, renamed_map, expanded_ref, generated, constant, default_empty, or default_null rule.

generated_field_policy.feature_flags: effective flags from active stage profile
generated_field_policy.empty_collections: must be emitted explicitly, never omitted
generated_field_policy.storage_containers: generated from initial_world.storage_containers, then reconciled from every storable runtime object with storage_ref and storage_footprint after all active overlays are merged; current Stage 1A storable types are MaterialLot and DishLot
generated_field_policy.inventory: generated from initial_world.initial_inventory plus active overlay inventory additions when a higher stage explicitly enables them; MaterialLot entries participate in StorageOccupant reconciliation
generated_field_policy.orders: generated from initial_world.initial_orders plus active overlay debug_orders when a debug profile explicitly enables them
generated_field_policy.family_state: generated from initial_world.family_state plus active overlay family_meal_state mapped to SaveFile.family_state.meal_state when Stage 1B or later is active
generated_field_policy.crop_instances: default empty list; plant_crop creates CropInstance and field active_crop_ids indexes it
generated_field_policy.reservations: default empty list; only cross-action/cross-save reservations persist here
generated_field_policy.dish_lots: default empty list; cook_dish creates DishLot entries and those entries participate in the same StorageOccupant reconciliation as MaterialLot

expanded_ref_policy.initial_tools_ref: must resolve to a non-empty initial_tools list and emit SaveFile.tools_state
expanded_ref_policy.initial_facilities_ref: must resolve to a non-empty initial_facilities list and emit SaveFile.facilities_state
expanded_ref_policy.initial_fuel_ref: must resolve to a non-empty initial_fuel object and emit SaveFile.fuel_state

expanded_ref_output_schema_policy.validation_required: NewGameBuilder must validate every expanded runtime state entry against its schema before SaveFile validation.

tools_and_facilities_state_semantics.condition: usable/worn/damaged wear condition; quality_tier stores craftsmanship tier only

runtime_initialization_policy.cook_dish_output_storage_policy: cook_dish may pass target_storage_ref; if omitted, NewGameBuilder/runtime uses default_dish_storage_ref. DishLot storage_ref must be filled before ActionResult is returned.

overlay_merge_policy.stage_1B_life_overlay.family_meal_state: merge into SaveFile.family_state.meal_state when Stage 1B profile is active
overlay_merge_policy.stage_1C_debug_overlay.debug_inventory_a: append to SaveFile.inventory before storage reconciliation when Stage 1C debug profile is active
overlay_merge_policy.stage_1C_debug_overlay.debug_orders: append to SaveFile.orders when Stage 1C debug profile is active
overlay_merge_policy.post_merge_storage_reconciliation: rebuild StorageContainer.active_object_refs and used_capacity from merged SaveFile inventory plus dish_lots storable objects; validate container existence, slot_weight unit, capacity overflow, and object-type/id uniqueness

storage_occupant_policy.storage_source: all SaveFile runtime objects whose schema requires storage_ref and storage_footprint
storage_occupant_policy.capacity_rule: sum slot_weight storage_footprint.amount across all active StorageOccupants referencing the container
storage_occupant_policy.material_lot_view_rule: MaterialLot-specific views may be derived for UI/debug, but the persisted storage cache authority is active_object_refs over all StorageOccupants.

action_pipeline_storage_invariant.post_success_rule: after every successful storage-mutating action, rebuild or incrementally update active_object_refs and used_capacity from StorageOccupants and then validate against full reconciliation
action_pipeline_storage_invariant.rollback_rule: if an action fails after reserving, consuming, creating, moving, or storing an object, restore inventory, dish_lots, reservations, fuel_state, orders, storage_containers, and domain_events to the pre-action transaction snapshot
action_pipeline_storage_invariant.event_rule: domain_events are committed only after storage and object lifecycle validation succeeds

configs/active_stage_1A/stage_1A_active_.purpose: 最小可玩经营闭环，不包含家庭饭食、水资源、医馆正式订单、旧案正式内容。
notes: Stage 1A 可以读取 home_water 字段以满足 SaveFile schema，但不得把扣水/挑水作为 Stage 1A 通过条件。
工具、设施、燃料在 Stage 1A 可以作为存在性与轻量消耗验证；完整耐久反馈归 Stage 1B。
ginger 作为可选调味料和供货引用进入 Stage 1A 配置闭环，但不是主线通关必需材料。
feature flags 以 active_stage_*/feature_flag_overrides.yaml 覆盖 core 默认值。

tests/expected/stage_1A_runtime_lifecycl.authority: Formal Stage 1A Action lifecycle contract for AI code generation and transaction tests.

global_invariants.post_success_storage_rule: Every successful storage-mutating action must leave active_object_refs and used_capacity equal to a full rebuild from StorageOccupants.
global_invariants.rollback_rule: Every failed action must restore inventory, dish_lots, reservations, fuel_state, orders, storage_containers, and domain_events to the pre-action snapshot for objects touched by that action.
global_invariants.domain_event_rule: DomainEvents are appended only after object writes and storage reconciliation validation succeed.
global_invariants.submit_order_consumption_rule: Stage 1A success: submitted DishLot is removed from SaveFile.dish_lots; Order.submitted_object_refs and DomainEvent retain submission history.

plant_crop.storage_cache_invariant: seed MaterialLot footprint/capacity must be reconciled after quantity change or lot consumption

advance_time.storage_cache_invariant: active_object_refs unchanged unless decay deletes or transforms a stored object; any such transform must reconcile storage cache

harvest_crop.storage_cache_invariant: created MaterialLot must enter active_object_refs with object_type MaterialLot before action result is returned
rollback_assertions: no harvested MaterialLot leaked on failure

store_item.storage_cache_invariant: moved object appears once in target container active_object_refs and zero times in previous container
rollback_assertions: source and target container caches restored on failure

split_lot.storage_cache_invariant: source and split MaterialLot footprints must be regenerated from definitions and reconciled
rollback_assertions: source lot quantity restored on failure
split lot not leaked on failure

start_processing.storage_cache_invariant: reserved/consumed input lots and facility container occupancy must reconcile before task is committed
rollback_assertions: input MaterialLot quantities restored on failure

collect_processing_result.storage_cache_invariant: output MaterialLot must enter active_object_refs and task cannot be collected twice
rollback_assertions: output MaterialLot not leaked on failure

cook_dish.storage_cache_invariant: created DishLot must enter active_object_refs with object_type DishLot; ingredient lots and capacity must reconcile after consumption

writes: DishLot or submitted object consumed/marked submitted
submit_order.storage_cache_invariant: submitted DishLot must be removed from SaveFile.dish_lots and absent from every StorageContainer.active_object_refs before order completion is committed; Order and DomainEvent retain submission history
rollback_assertions: submitted object storage state restored on failure

after_cook_dish.required_cache_effect: created_ref appears exactly once in target StorageContainer.active_object_refs and its storage_footprint.amount is included in used_capacity

after_submit_order.required_savefile_effect: submitted DishLot is removed from SaveFile.dish_lots in Stage 1A
after_submit_order.required_cache_effect: submitted_ref is absent from all StorageContainer.active_object_refs and used_capacity is rebuilt after removal
after_submit_order.history_retention: Order.submitted_object_refs and DomainEvent payload retain audit history; Stage 1A removes the DishLot runtime object instead of retaining a detached runtime object.

tests/expected/stage_1A_runtime_feature_.runtime_gate_policy: normal child gates require parents; debug_overlay_gate uses allowed_stages and does not open normal gameplay parent pools
